key.name: startup-modes
key.summary: Per VPN: what happens after a restart ("uuid\tmode")
key.description: mode: restore (reconnect if it was on; also the default for VPNs not listed), always (connect at startup and reconnect when it drops, Android "Always-on VPN"), never (stay off). Written by Settings > VPN.

key.name: last-active
key.summary: UUIDs of the VPNs the user last left on (written by fp6-vpn-restore)
key.description: Added when a VPN connects, removed only when the user switches it off; drops for other reasons (no network, shutdown) keep it.

key.name: connections
key.summary: NetworkManager VPN profiles for Settings ("uuid\tname\tstate"; written by fp6-vpn-restore)
key.description: state: on, connecting, waiting (will be reconnected once a network is up), off.
